Class ServerProxyRMI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.client.serverproxy.ServerProxyRMI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerProxy, AutoCloseable
public class ServerProxyRMI extends Object implements ServerProxy
RMI implementation of the ServerProxy contract.

This class is the client-side remote proxy used by the user interface to send commands to the server. The UI talks to the ServerProxy interface, so it does not need to know whether the concrete connection is implemented with TCP or RMI.

In the RMI implementation, outgoing user commands are sent by calling methods on the remote RmiServerService stub returned by the connection service. Incoming server messages travel in the opposite direction through VirtualServerRMI, which is passed to the server as the client callback.

This class owns the outbound direction and the connection state. If a remote call fails, the proxy marks itself as disconnected and reports a local connection error to the client view through the callback receiver.

    • sendPong

      public void sendPong()
      Sends a PONG message to the server.

      This method is called by VirtualServerRMI when a PING message is received from the server. It is part of the RMI connection keep-alive flow, not a command entered directly by the user.

    • close

      public void close() throws IOException
      Closes the RMI session owned by this proxy.

      The remote session is closed first when a server stub exists. The local callback receiver is closed in the finally block so that local callback resources are released even if the remote close fails.

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
      Specified by:
      close in interface ServerProxy
      Throws:
      IOException - if the remote session or the local callback receiver cannot be closed
